title: Sony patent outlines credit card reader for PlayStation controllers
excerpt: A newly published Sony patent suggests future PlayStation controllers could feature a built-in credit card reader for digital purchases.
body_html:
A patent filed by Sony describes a potential hardware addition for future PlayStation controllers: an integrated credit card reader.

As the gaming industry continues its shift toward a digital-only era, the proposed technology aims to simplify the process of making online purchases directly through the gamepad.

While patents do not always translate into immediate commercial products, the concept points to ways hardware manufacturers might streamline digital transactions on upcoming gaming systems.
